passages.text: These are the last words of David: “The oracle of David son of Jesse, the oracle of the man raised on high, the one anointed by the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel: The Spirit of the LORD spoke through me; His word was on my tongue.
passages.sermon:
David was the son of Jesse.
God chose David and raised him up.
God anointed David as king over Israel.
David wrote many songs for Israel.
These are the last words of David.
The Spirit of the LORD spoke through David.
God’s word was on David’s tongue.
passages.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה דִּבְרֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד הָאַֽחֲרֹנִ֑ים נְאֻ֧ם דָּוִ֣ד בֶּן־ יִשַׁ֗י וּנְאֻ֤ם הַגֶּ֙בֶר֙ הֻ֣קַם עָ֔ל מְשִׁ֙יחַ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וּנְעִ֖ים זְמִר֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ ר֥וּחַ יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֶּר־ בִּ֑י וּמִלָּת֖וֹ עַל־ לְשׁוֹנִֽי׃

passages.text: The God of Israel spoke; the Rock of Israel said to me, ‘He who rules the people with justice, who rules in the fear of God, is like the light of the morning at sunrise of a cloudless dawn, the glistening after the rain on the sprouting grass of the earth.’
passages.sermon:
The God of Israel spoke to me.
The Rock of Israel said these words to me.
A ruler must lead people with justice.
A righteous ruler must rule with the fear of God.
Such a ruler is like the morning light at sunrise.
He is like the sun shining on a cloudless morning.
He is like brightness after rain.
He is like grass growing from the earth after the rain.
passages.original: אָמַר֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ֥י דִבֶּ֖ר צ֣וּר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מוֹשֵׁל֙ בָּאָדָ֔ם צַדִּ֕יק מוֹשֵׁ֖ל יִרְאַ֥ת אֱלֹהִֽים׃ וּכְא֥וֹר בֹּ֖קֶר יִזְרַח־ שָׁ֑מֶשׁ בֹּ֚קֶר לֹ֣א עָב֔וֹת מִנֹּ֥גַהּ מִמָּטָ֖ר דֶּ֥שֶׁא מֵאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Is not my house right with God? For He has established with me an everlasting covenant, ordered and secured in every part. Will He not bring about my full salvation and my every desire?
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
God chose David and made him king.
God made a promise to David.
This promise is an everlasting covenant.
God arranged this covenant in every detail.
God keeps this covenant safe and secure.
God will bring me full salvation.
God will fulfill all my desires.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ לֹא־ כֵ֥ן בֵּיתִ֖י עִם־ אֵ֑ל כִּי֩ בְרִ֨ית עוֹלָ֜ם שָׂ֣ם לִ֗י עֲרוּכָ֤ה בַכֹּל֙ וּשְׁמֻרָ֔ה כִּֽי־ כָל־ יִשְׁעִ֥י וְכָל־ חֵ֖פֶץ כִּֽי־ לֹ֥א יַצְמִֽיחַ׃

passages.text: But the worthless are all like thorns raked aside, for they can never be gathered by hand.
passages.sermon: Worthless people are like thorns.\r\nSomeone rakes all the thorns aside.\r\nNo one gathers them by hand.
passages.original: וּבְלִיַּ֕עַל כְּק֥וֹץ מֻנָ֖ד כֻּלָּ֑הַם כִּֽי־ לֹ֥א בְיָ֖ד יִקָּֽחוּ׃

passages.text: The man who touches them must be armed with iron or with the shaft of a spear. The fire burns them to ashes in the place where they lie.”
passages.sermon:
A man tries to touch the worthless people.
He must use iron or the shaft of a spear.
He cannot handle them with his bare hands.
Fire will burn them where they lie.
The fire will turn them to ashes.
passages.original: וְאִישׁ֙ יִגַּ֣ע בָּהֶ֔ם יִמָּלֵ֥א בַרְזֶ֖ל וְעֵ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית וּבָאֵ֕שׁ שָׂר֥וֹף יִשָּׂרְפ֖וּ בַּשָּֽׁבֶת׃פ

passages.text: These are the names of David’s mighty men: Josheb-basshebeth the Tahchemonite was chief of the Three. He wielded his spear against eight hundred men, whom he killed at one time.
passages.sermon:
David had mighty men.
These men were famous for their strength and bravery.
Josheb-basshebeth was one of these men.
He was called the Tahchemonite.
He was the chief of the Three.
He fought with his spear.
He fought against eight hundred men at one time.
He killed all eight hundred men in that one battle.
passages.original: אֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת הַגִּבֹּרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְדָוִ֑ד יֹשֵׁ֨ב בַּשֶּׁ֜בֶת תַּחְכְּמֹנִ֣י׀ רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׁלִשִׁ֗י ה֚וּא עֲדִינ֣וֹ הָעֶצְנוֹ עַל־ שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֛וֹת חָלָ֖ל בְּפַ֥עַם אֶחָד׃ס

passages.text: Next in command was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite. As one of the three mighty men, he went with David to taunt the Philistines who had gathered for battle at Pas-dammim. The men of Israel retreated, but Eleazar stood his ground and struck the Philistines until his hand grew weary and stuck to his sword. The LORD brought about a great victory that day. Then the troops returned to him, but only to plunder the dead.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar was the son of Dodo.
Eleazar was an Ahohite.
Eleazar was one of the three mighty men of David.
Eleazar went with David.
They taunted the Philistines.
The Philistines had gathered for battle at Pas-dammim.
The men of Israel retreated from the battle.
Eleazar stood his ground.
Eleazar struck the Philistines.
He fought until his hand grew tired.
His hand stuck to his sword.
The LORD gave a great victory that day.
The troops returned to Eleazar.
They returned only to plunder the dead.
passages.original: וְאַחֲרוֹ אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּן־ דֹּדִי בֶּן־ אֲחֹחִ֑י בִּשְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה גִבֹּרִים עִם־ דָּוִ֗ד בְּחָֽרְפָ֤ם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ־ שָׁ֣ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַֽיַּעֲל֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ ה֣וּא קָם֩ וַיַּ֨ךְ בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֜ים עַ֣ד׀ כִּֽי־ יָגְעָ֣ה יָד֗וֹ וַתִּדְבַּ֤ק יָדוֹ֙ אֶל־ הַחֶ֔רֶב וַיַּ֧עַשׂ יְהוָ֛ה תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וְהָעָ֛ם יָשֻׁ֥בוּ אַחֲרָ֖יו אַךְ־ לְפַשֵּֽׁט׃ס

passages.text: And after him was Shammah son of Agee the Hararite. When the Philistines had banded together near a field full of lentils, Israel’s troops fled from them.
passages.sermon:
Shammah was the son of Agee.
Shammah was a Hararite.
Shammah was one of David’s mighty men.
After Eleazar, Shammah is named.
The Philistines gathered together for battle.
They gathered near a field.
The field was full of lentils.
The men of Israel saw the Philistines.
The men of Israel ran away from the Philistines.
passages.original: וְאַחֲרָ֛יו שַׁמָּ֥א בֶן־ אָגֵ֖א הָרָרִ֑י וַיֵּאָסְפ֨וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֜ים לַחַיָּ֗ה וַתְּהִי־ שָׁ֞ם חֶלְקַ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ מְלֵאָ֣ה עֲדָשִׁ֔ים וְהָעָ֥ם נָ֖ס מִפְּנֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

passages.text: But Shammah took his stand in the middle of the field, defended it, and struck down the Philistines. So the LORD brought about a great victory.
passages.sermon:
Shammah was the son of Agee the Hararite.
He stood in the middle of the field.
He defended the field.
He struck down the Philistines.
The LORD gave a great victory.
passages.original: וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֤ב בְּתוֹךְ־ הַֽחֶלְקָה֙ וַיַּצִּילֶ֔הָ וַיַּ֖ךְ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ יְהוָ֖ה תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃ס

passages.text: At harvest time, three of the thirty chief men went down to David at the cave of Adullam, while a company of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
passages.sermon:
Three of the thirty chief men were mighty warriors of Israel.
It was harvest time.
These three men went down to David.
David was at the cave of Adullam.
At the same time, a company of Philistines was encamped.
The Philistines were in the Valley of Rephaim.
passages.original: וַיֵּרְד֨וּ שְׁלֹשִׁים מֵהַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֣ים רֹ֗אשׁ וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ אֶל־ קָצִיר֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֔ד אֶל־ מְעָרַ֖ת עֲדֻלָּ֑ם וְחַיַּ֣ת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים חֹנָ֖ה בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃

passages.text: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was at Bethlehem.
passages.sermon: David was in the stronghold at that time.\r\nThe Philistines had a garrison at Bethlehem.
passages.original: וְדָוִ֖ד אָ֣ז בַּמְּצוּדָ֑ה וּמַצַּ֣ב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָ֖ז בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃

passages.text: David longed for water and said, “Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!”
passages.sermon:
David was in the stronghold.
David was the leader of his men.
David felt very thirsty.
David wanted water.
David spoke to his men.
David said, "Who will bring me water?"
David wanted water from a special place.
David wanted water from the well.
The well was near the gate of Bethlehem.
passages.original: וַיִּתְאַוֶּ֥ה דָוִ֖ד וַיֹּאמַ֑ר מִ֚י יַשְׁקֵ֣נִי מַ֔יִם מִבֹּ֥אר בֵּֽית־ לֶ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃

passages.text: So the three mighty men broke through the Philistine camp, drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the LORD, saying, “Far be it from me, O LORD, to do this! Is this not the blood of the men who risked their lives?” So he refused to drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.
passages.sermon:
Three mighty men served David.
They broke through the Philistine camp.
They drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem.
They carried the water to David.
David refused to drink the water.
He poured the water out to the LORD.
David said, “Far be it from me, O LORD, to do this!”
He said, “Is this not the blood of the men who risked their lives?”
David would not drink the water.
These were the exploits of the three mighty men.
passages.original: וַיִּבְקְעוּ֩ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הַגִּבֹּרִ֜ים בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיִּֽשְׁאֲבוּ־ מַ֙יִם֙ מִבֹּ֤אר בֵּֽית־ לֶ֙חֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשַּׁ֔עַר וַיִּשְׂא֖וּ וַיָּבִ֣אוּ אֶל־ דָּוִ֑ד וְלֹ֤א אָבָה֙ לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֔ם וַיַּסֵּ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖ם לַֽיהוָֽה׃ וַיֹּ֡אמֶר חָלִילָה֩ לִּ֨י יְהוָ֜ה מֵעֲשֹׂ֣תִי זֹ֗את הֲדַ֤ם הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ הַהֹלְכִ֣ים בְּנַפְשׁוֹתָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה עָשׂ֔וּ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃ס

passages.text: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab and son of Zeruiah, was chief of the Three, and he lifted his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and won a name along with the Three.
passages.sermon:
Abishai was the brother of Joab.
Abishai was the son of Zeruiah.
Abishai was chief of the Three mighty men.
Abishai lifted his spear against three hundred men.
Abishai killed those three hundred men.
Abishai won a name among the Three mighty men.
passages.original: וַאֲבִישַׁ֞י אֲחִ֣י׀ יוֹאָ֣ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֗ה ה֚וּא רֹ֣אשׁ הַשְּׁלֹשִׁי וְהוּא֙ עוֹרֵ֣ר אֶת־ חֲנִית֔וֹ עַל־ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָלָ֑ל וְלוֹ־ שֵׁ֖ם בַּשְּׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: Was he not more honored than the Three? And he became their commander, even though he was not included among the Three.
passages.sermon:
Abishai was the brother of Joab and the son of Zeruiah.
Abishai was chief of the Three mighty men.
Abishai was more honored than the Three.
Abishai became their commander.
Abishai was not included among the Three.
passages.original: מִן־ הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה֙ הֲכִ֣י נִכְבָּ֔ד וַיְהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם לְשָׂ֑ר וְעַד־ הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא־ בָֽא׃ס

passages.text: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a man of valor from Kabzeel, a man of many exploits. He struck down two champions of Moab, and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion.
passages.sermon:
Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada.
Jehoiada was the son of a valiant man from Kabzeel.
Benaiah was a man of valor.
Benaiah accomplished many exploits.
Benaiah struck down two champions from Moab.
On a snowy day, Benaiah went down into a pit.
Benaiah killed a lion inside the pit.
passages.original: וּבְנָיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֧ע בֶּן־ אִֽישׁ־ חַי רַב־ פְּעָלִ֖ים מִֽקַּבְצְאֵ֑ל ה֣וּא הִכָּ֗ה אֵ֣ת שְׁנֵ֤י אֲרִאֵל֙ מוֹאָ֔ב וְ֠הוּא יָרַ֞ד וְהִכָּ֧ה אֶֽת־ הָאֲרִיַּה בְּת֥וֹךְ הַבֹּ֖אר בְּי֥וֹם הַשָּֽׁלֶג׃

passages.text: He also killed an Egyptian, a huge man. Although the Egyptian had a spear in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club, snatched the spear from his hand, and killed the Egyptian with his own spear.
passages.sermon:
Benaiah was a man of valor from Kabzeel.
He performed many great deeds.
Benaiah faced an Egyptian man.
The Egyptian was very tall and strong.
The Egyptian held a spear in his hand.
Benaiah approached the Egyptian with only a club.
Benaiah took the spear from the Egyptian’s hand.
Benaiah killed the Egyptian with the same spear.
passages.original: וְהוּא־ הִכָּה֩ אֶת־ אִ֨ישׁ מִצְרִ֜י אֲשֶׁר מַרְאֶ֗ה וּבְיַ֤ד הַמִּצְרִי֙ חֲנִ֔ית וַיֵּ֥רֶד אֵלָ֖יו בַּשָּׁ֑בֶט וַיִּגְזֹ֤ל אֶֽת־ הַחֲנִית֙ מִיַּ֣ד הַמִּצְרִ֔י וַיַּהַרְגֵ֖הוּ בַּחֲנִיתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: These were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who won a name alongside the three mighty men.
passages.sermon:
Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada.
Benaiah was a man of valor from Kabzeel.
Benaiah accomplished many great deeds.
These are the exploits Benaiah did.
Benaiah became famous among the three mighty men.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה עָשָׂ֔ה בְּנָיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וְלוֹ־ שֵׁ֖ם בִּשְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃

passages.text: He was most honored among the Thirty, but he did not become one of the Three. And David appointed him over his guard.
passages.sermon:
Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a mighty warrior.
He was the most honored among the Thirty.
He did not become one of the Three.
David appointed Benaiah over his guard.
passages.original: מִן־ הַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֣ים נִכְבָּ֔ד וְאֶל־ הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא־ בָ֑א וַיְשִׂמֵ֥הוּ דָוִ֖ד אֶל־ מִשְׁמַעְתּֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Now these were members of the Thirty: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem, Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite, Helez the Paltite, Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite, Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite, Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the Benjamites, Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai from the brooks of Gaash, Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan son of Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam son of Sharar the Hararite, Eliphelet son of Ahasbai the Maacathite, Eliam son of Ahithophel the Gilonite, Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite, Igal son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite, Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah, Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite, and Uriah the Hittite. There were thirty-seven in all.
passages.sermon:
These men were members of David’s group called the Thirty.
Asahel was the brother of Joab.
Elhanan was the son of Dodo from Bethlehem.
Shammah was a Harodite.
Elika was a Harodite.
Helez was a Paltite.
Ira was the son of Ikkesh from Tekoa.
Abiezer was from Anathoth.
Mebunnai was a Hushathite.
Zalmon was an Ahohite.
Maharai was from Netophah.
Heled was the son of Baanah from Netophah.
Ittai was the son of Ribai from Gibeah in the tribe of Benjamin.
Benaiah was from Pirathon.
Hiddai was from the brooks of Gaash.
Abi-albon was from the Arabah.
Azmaveth was a Barhumite.
Eliahba was from Shaalbon.
The sons of Jashen were included.
Jonathan was the son of Shammah from the mountains.
Ahiam was the son of Sharar from the mountains.
Eliphelet was the son of Ahasbai from Maacah.
Eliam was the son of Ahithophel from Giloh.
Hezro was a Carmelite.
Paarai was an Arbite.
Igal was the son of Nathan from Zobah.
Bani was a Gadite.
Zelek was an Ammonite.
Naharai was from Beeroth.
Naharai carried the weapons of Joab, the son of Zeruiah.
Ira was an Ithrite.
Gareb was an Ithrite.
Uriah was a Hittite.
There were thirty-seven men in all.
passages.original: עֲשָׂה־ אֵ֥ל אֲחִֽי־ יוֹאָ֖ב בַּשְּׁלֹשִׁ֑ים אֶלְחָנָ֥ן בֶּן־ דֹּד֖וֹ בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃ שַׁמָּה֙ הַֽחֲרֹדִ֔י אֱלִיקָ֖א הַחֲרֹדִֽי׃ס חֶ֚לֶץ הַפַּלְטִ֔י עִירָ֥א בֶן־ עִקֵּ֖שׁ הַתְּקוֹעִֽי׃ס אֲבִיעֶ֙זֶר֙ הָֽעַנְּתֹתִ֔י מְבֻנַּ֖י הַחֻשָׁתִֽי׃ס צַלְמוֹן֙ הָֽאֲחֹחִ֔י מַהְרַ֖י הַנְּטֹפָתִֽי׃ס חֵ֥לֶב בֶּֽן־ בַּעֲנָ֖ה הַנְּטֹפָתִ֑יס אִתַּי֙ בֶּן־ רִיבַ֔י מִגִּבְעַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִֽן׃ס בְּנָיָ֙הוּ֙ פִּרְעָ֣תֹנִ֔י הִדַּ֖י מִנַּ֥חֲלֵי גָֽעַשׁ׃ס אֲבִֽי־ עַלְבוֹן֙ הָֽעַרְבָתִ֔י עַזְמָ֖וֶת הַבַּרְחֻמִֽי׃ס אֶלְיַחְבָּא֙ הַשַּׁ֣עַלְבֹנִ֔י בְּנֵ֥י יָשֵׁ֖ן יְהוֹנָתָֽן׃ס שַׁמָּה֙ הַֽהֲרָרִ֔י אֲחִיאָ֥ם בֶּן־ שָׁרָ֖ר הָארָרִֽי׃ס אֱלִיפֶ֥לֶט בֶּן־ אֲחַסְבַּ֖י בֶּן־ הַמַּֽעֲכָתִ֑יס אֱלִיעָ֥ם בֶּן־ אֲחִיתֹ֖פֶל הַגִּלֹנִֽי׃ס חֶצְרוֹ הַֽכַּרְמְלִ֔י פַּעֲרַ֖י הָאַרְבִּֽי׃ס יִגְאָ֤ל בֶּן־ נָתָן֙ מִצֹּבָ֔הס בָּנִ֖י הַגָּדִֽי׃ס צֶ֖לֶק הָעַמֹּנִ֑יס נַחְרַי֙ הַבְּאֵ֣רֹתִ֔י נֹשְׂאֵי כְּלֵ֖י יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־ צְרֻיָֽה׃ס עִירָא֙ הַיִּתְרִ֔י גָּרֵ֖ב הַיִּתְרִֽי׃ס אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַֽחִתִּ֔י כֹּ֖ל שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃פ
